eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Lassen, CA; at 11:30 AM on AUG 17, 2021 Effective until 11:30 AM AUG 18, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
NEW MANDATORY EVACUATION ORDER  has been issued for east of Hwy 395 from the Milford Grade intersection south to the Flux Rd intersection

NEW EVACUATION WARNINGS have been issued for:
Lake Forest Estates and Eagle Lake Road A1 from Hwy 36 north to the County Access gate and east to Prattville Rd and north to Paiute Creek.

West of Hwy 395 from the A25 Herlong Access Rd intersection south to the A26 Garnier Rd intersection

ALL PREVIOUSLY ISSUED ORDERS AND WARNINGS REMAIN IN PLACE

ROAD CLOSURES:  
County Road A21 is closed to southbound traffic from Hwy 44
Hwy 36 is closed west of Eagle Lake Rd A1
Hwy 395 from A25 to Hwy 36 at Richmond Rd


Safety Message: People under evacuation order should leave immediately.  Those under warning who require assistance and those with pets and livestock should leave now.  Use caution, drive with your headlights on and yield to emergency personnel. Call dispatch for assistance evacuating 530-257-6121. An Emergency Shelter is located at Lassen Community College in Susanville.  The Shelter number is (530) 250-9004.  Large animals can be taken to Lassen County Fairgrounds.  Deputies will be going door to door to make notifications
